description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
待查询数据目的配置是否为转发错误操作数据，即转发流转到其他云产品失败且重试失败的数据。

- **true**：是转发错误操作数据。
- **false**（默认）：不是转发错误操作数据，而是正常转发操作。
description.en:
Indicates whether the data destination configuration to be queried is for forwarding fault operation data, that is, data whose forwarding to other cloud products has failed and retries have also failed.

- **true**: The data is fault forwarding operation data.
- **false** (default): The data is normal forwarding operation data, not fault forwarding operation data.

description.zh: 解析器ID。您可调用接口[ListParsers](~~429046~~)，查询解析器列表，获取**ParserId**。
description.en: The resolver ID. You can call the [ListParsers](~~429046~~) API to query the resolver list and obtain the **ParserId**.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot list-parser-destination --is-failover false --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --parser-id 1002 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
